'''2010 Canadian Nationals Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hoth CRV
* '''Username:''' Blarg
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
